Summaries.eng: Sora's dad sends him a mummy from Egypt. It's tiny, shy, and adorable. Now Sora's got a palm-sized problem named Mii-kun.
Summaries.jpn:
ごく普通の生活を送る男子高校生・柏木空は
ある日、旅先のエジプトにいる自称"冒険家"の父から突如、ミイラを送りつけられる。
「面白いミイラを見つけたからお前に預けることにした！」と
書かれた父の手紙におののく空。
だが、送られてきた大きな棺から現れたのは、全長12cm！？
なんと手のひらサイズのミイラだった…。
小さい上に、臆病で、泣き虫、でも何ともいえない可愛さの
ミイラにミーくんと名づけ面倒を見ることになる空。
一つ屋根の下、一緒に暮らし始める空とミーくんの共同生活とは・・・・。

Summaries.eng: Sora's dad sends him a mummy from Egypt. It's tiny, shy, and adorable. Now Sora's got a palm-sized problem named Mii-kun.

Titles.eng: White, Round, Tiny, Wimpy, and Ready
Titles.jpn: しろくてまるくてちいさくて とても泣きむしだけどがんばる

Summaries.eng: Sora receives a package from his dad in Egypt: a huge casket with a tiny mummy. The instructions are unclear, but what’s certain is that he’s going to have to learn to take care of his new mummy, Mii-kun.

Titles.eng: Toyed With and Chased Around, Being Small Is Hard
Titles.jpn: いじわるされたりおいかけられたり 小さいということはとってもたいへん

Summaries.eng: Balancing school and taking care of Mii-kun turns out to be a challenge, but with a little help from his friend, Tazuki, Sora takes it on like a champ.

Titles.eng: It's Scary When Someone You Care About Gets Sick
Titles.jpn: たいせつなひとが風ぜをひいたら とてもしんぱい

Summaries.eng: Sora comes down with the flu. Kaede and Mii-kun are desperate to help, but his strong sense of independence makes him a little difficult to care for.

Titles.eng: You Can't Play Tag by Yourself, and It's Fun to Play With Others
Titles.jpn: おにごっこはひとりではできないし いっしょは楽しい

Summaries.eng: Tazuki encounters a child oni on his way home from work. Though the oni appears to be beat up pretty badly, Tazuki refuses to take him in.

Titles.eng: Go Away Kindness, Go Away Fear
Titles.jpn: やさしい気もちこわいのとんでけ

Summaries.eng: Mogi comes home to a tiny dragon hanging out in her room. This is terrible news to her, as she has a fear of lizards.

Titles.eng: I Can't Grow All at Once, So I'll Grow Over Time
Titles.jpn: きゅうにはむりだから ちょっとずつ大きくなるよ

Summaries.eng: Mii-kun, Conny and Isao learn to write – kind of. Kaede’s mandrake gets loose, and the gang sets out to bring it home before the unthinkable happens.

Titles.eng: Scary Dreams Are Okay Because I'm Not Alone
Titles.jpn: こわい夢みてもひとりじゃ ないからだいじょうぶ

Summaries.eng: A student with a menacing look threatens the gang. There seems to be something wrong with him. Sora offers him his help.

Titles.eng: New Places, Strange Places, Strange Friends
Titles.jpn: あたらしいとこふしぎなとこ ふしぎな友だち

Summaries.eng: The gang finds a perfect babysitter for their creatures. From there, Mii-kun sets out on an unintended adventure.

Titles.jpn: やさしい手あたたかい手

Summaries.eng: Conny has developed some bad habits, including stealing food from the family. His relationship with Tazuki becomes strained.

Titles.jpn: とおくからきた楽しいびっくり

Summaries.eng: Sora’s dad sends him another gift. It doesn’t seem to be dangerous in any way, but it sure is talkative.

Titles.eng: I Want to Be With You Forever and Ever
Titles.jpn: ずっとずっといっしょにいたいと思ってるから

Summaries.eng: Sora’s classmate, Suzuki, shows him a photo of an injured inugami. Sora and the gang head out to the mountains to find it.
A collector has gotten a hold of Mii-kun. The gang works together to stop him.
